gold.note: Darkened from an earlier #C9A227 for text contrast (2.26:1 -> ~4.8:1 on Canvas) — same hue/saturation, not a hue shift.

display.purpose: Once per screen at most — auth headlines, hero titles. Never inside a list or card.

headline.purpose: Header bar titles, modal titles, section titles.

title.purpose: Card and list-item primary text — product/user/item names.

label.purpose: Badges, stat labels, timestamps, meta text.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Reserved for surfaces that need to lift off a busy background (Cart, Checkout, Shop). Not the default card treatment.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only button style used for a screen's main action (Sign In, Add to Cart, Place Order).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C4623E; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; transition: opacity 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4623E; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FAF7F2; color: #1C1B1A; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #E8E1D5; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F3EFE7; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4623E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Delete/deactivate confirmations only — Rust, never Clay, so it never reads as a primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #C4463E; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; transition: opacity 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4463E; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card (flat)
components.description: The app's standard card — a 1px Line border does the separating, not a shadow. Every card and card-shaped list row passes variant="flat" explicitly.
components.html:
Vintage Denim Jacket
₱450.00 · Ukay-Ukay
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FAF7F2; border: 1px solid #E8E1D5; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { color: #1C1B1A; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-card-body { color: #6B655C; font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Card (elevated)
components.description: The Card component's default parameter value, kept for backward compatibility — used on Cart, Checkout, and Shop, where a card needs to lift off a busier background.
components.css: .ds-card-elevated { background: #FAF7F2; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(28,27,26,0.08); } .ds-card-title { color: #1C1B1A; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Canvas background, Line border, Ash placeholder — shared by every text field in the app via the Input component.
components.css: .ds-input-group { margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-input-label { display: block; color: #1C1B1A; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-input-field { width: 100%; background: #FAF7F2; border: 1px solid #E8E1D5; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 16px; color: #1C1B1A; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input-field::placeholder { color: #6B655C; } .ds-input-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4623E; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Tinted pill — background is the role color at 20% opacity, text is the same color at full opacity. Used for category and status tags.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; background: rgba(91,107,79,0.2); color: #5B6B4F; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Cart Count Badge
components.description: The one solid-fill badge exception — overlays the bottom-nav cart icon.
components.css: .ds-cart-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 16px; height: 16px; padding: 0 3px; background: #C4463E; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
PlainCo reads like a trusted local shop, not a marketplace app fighting for a tap. The palette is warm without being precious — clay, moss, and gold sit on a soft canvas instead of stark white, but the warmth is carried by accent color and typography, never by decoration. Every screen — from the customer shop floor to the admin dashboard — shares the same handful of components (Button, Input, Card, Badge, EmptyState), so the system feels consistent whether you're browsing ukay-ukay finds or an admin is reviewing orders.

The system explicitly rejects generic marketplace clutter: no countdown timers, no stacked discount badges, no red/orange flash-sale banners competing for attention. It also rejects sterile minimalist tech — PlainCo should feel human and a little unhurried, not clinical. Surfaces stay flat by default (a 1px line, not a shadow) because a thrift counter doesn't need to shout about depth; it needs to be legible and calm.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, restrained palette: one clay accent for primary actions, moss and gold reserved for secondary/semantic roles
Flat-by-default surfaces — a hairline border does the separating, not elevation
One shared component vocabulary across customer and admin surfaces
Native system type (San Francisco on iOS, Roboto on Android) — no custom display font
Native, dual-target platform: the same brand system renders on iOS and Android; OS conventions are respected in behavior (gestures, safe areas), not overridden in look

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Clay is the only color used for primary calls-to-action and active/selected states. Moss and Gold have their own dedicated jobs (category, money) — they never substitute for Clay on a button.

rules.name: The No-Shout Rule
rules.body: Warmth comes from Clay, Moss, and Gold used deliberately — never from tinting the whole background warm "for elegance." Canvas stays a true off-white; the accent colors carry the personality.

rules.name: The Dark Mode Note
rules.body: constants/theme.ts defines a complete Colors.dark palette, but no screen currently reads it — every screen imports Colors.light directly with no theme-switching logic. Treat Colors.light as the only shipped theme until a dark-mode toggle is actually wired up.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: There is no second typeface anywhere in the app. Hierarchy is built entirely from size and weight, never from a display font swapped in for hero moments.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A card is a bordered rectangle, not a shadowed one. Reach for Card's elevated variant (Shadow.card) only when a surface genuinely needs to separate from a busy background, not as a default "make it look premium" move. Every other card in the app passes variant="flat" explicitly.

dos: Do use Clay (#C4623E) as the only primary-action color — buttons, active states, selected filters.
Do default every card and list row to a 1px Line border with no shadow; reach for Shadow.card only on a surface that truly needs to lift.
Do keep Moss as both the Ukay-Ukay category accent and the success color — don't introduce a second green.
Do keep type to one system family, building hierarchy from size and weight only.
Do use the shared Button / Input / Badge / Card / EmptyState components on new screens. A tappable card is TouchableOpacity wrapping <Card variant="flat">, not a hand-rolled bordered View.
donts: Don't ship Shopee/Lazada-style marketplace clutter — no countdown timers, no stacked discount badges, no red/orange flash-sale banners.
Don't tint the base Canvas background warm "for elegance." Canvas stays a true off-white.
Don't reach for a gradient text fill, a colored side-stripe border, or glassmorphism as decoration.
Don't design against Colors.dark as if it's live — it's defined but not wired up.
Don't let a destructive action borrow Clay. Rust is the only color for delete/deactivate/error.
